description: Get a player's achievement progress for one game (unlocked count, % complete, per-achievement unlock dates) by SteamID64 + appid — `unlocked`/`completion_pct` always reflect the full list, but the per-achievement `achievements` array is capped at 200, unlocked first (check `returned` vs `total` — most games have far fewer). For the game's full achievement list (names, descriptions, global rarity) independent of any player, use get_game_achievements instead; for just the rarity without a key, use get_global_achievements. Requires STEAM_API_KEY and a public profile with game-details visibility — otherwise it returns found:false — which is also what a game the player doesn't own, a SteamID64 with no account behind it, or no such appid at all returns; a game without achievements comes back as found:false or as found:true with total:0, as Steam answers it. Steam doesn't tell most of these apart, so `reason` says what it didn't return and which tools establish why (get_player_summary, get_owned_games' check_appids, get_game).

appid.description: Steam application id (appid). Get it from search_games.

language.description: Language for achievement names/descriptions (Steam's own name, e.g. russian); overrides STEAM_LANGUAGE.

steamid.description: 17-digit SteamID64. Omit to use the STEAM_ID configured on the server. Convert a vanity/custom URL name with resolve_vanity_url first.

name.description: Display name, falling back to the achievement's internal api name when Valve's schema has no localized title for it.

game.description: The game's name from Valve's achievement schema — occasionally an internal dev codename rather than the store title (e.g. 'Fiber' for Persona 5 Royal). Treat the appid you passed as the reliable identifier, or get the store title from get_game.
